item.text: {"summary":"Accept rvalue-reference qualifiers in demangled function types.","explanation":"The failure shows function types ending in the Itanium ABI `O` qualifier are rejected, while the corresponding `R` qualifier already passes. Extend the existing qualifier check to accept `O` as well.","edits":[{"path":"absl/debugging/internal/demangle.cc","old":"if (state->mangled_cur[0] == 'R') {","new":"if (state->mangled_cur[0] == 'R' || state->mangled_cur[0] == 'O') {"}]}
